# Server experience: UI

`cinnabar:server-experience/ui@1.5.0`

Host-owned JSON-UI widgets and the bundle's signed modal screens.
Player mods import this interface's types; its functions are available only to client parts.

**Grants:** The signed client bundle's `ui` permission for widgets and `modal_ui` for modal mutations; modal-size reads the current admitted modal.

## Types

<a id="type-value"></a>

### `value`

A value bound into a screen property, in the forms the JSON-UI engine's bindings read:
`numbers` carries arrays such as a colour `[r, g, b, a]` or an offset `[x, y]`.

```wit
variant value {
    boolean(bool),
    integer(s64),
    number(f64),
    text(string),
    numbers(list<f64>),
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `boolean` | `bool` |  |
| `integer` | `s64` |  |
| `number` | `f64` |  |
| `text` | `string` |  |
| `numbers` | `list<f64>` |  |

<a id="type-gui-size"></a>

### `gui-size`

The size the open modal lays out in, as the vanilla screens' root does: `width` and
`height` in GUI units, and `scale`, the window's logical pixels per GUI unit (the GUI
scale).

```wit
record gui-size {
    width: f64,
    height: f64,
    scale: f64,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | `f64` |  |
| `height` | `f64` |  |
| `scale` | `f64` |  |

<a id="type-scroll-range"></a>

### `scroll-range`

What a scroll view shows along its scrolling axis, in GUI units: how far its content is
scrolled (`offset`, from 0 to `content` - `viewport`), the length of its viewport, and the
length of its content.

```wit
record scroll-range {
    offset: f64,
    viewport: f64,
    content: f64,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `offset` | `f64` |  |
| `viewport` | `f64` |  |
| `content` | `f64` |  |

## Functions

<a id="set-widget"></a>

### `set-widget`

```wit
set-widget: func(id: string, text: string) -> result<_, string>;
```

Sets one declared widget's plain text under this bundle's UI permission.

<a id="open-screen"></a>

### `open-screen`

```wit
open-screen: func(template: option<string>) -> result<_, string>;
```

Opens (or switches to) a template the manifest indexes under `templates`, as a modal
over gameplay; `none` closes the modal.

<a id="close-screen"></a>

### `close-screen`

```wit
close-screen: func() -> result<_, string>;
```

Closes this bundle's modal screen without selecting another template.

<a id="set-collection"></a>

### `set-collection`

```wit
set-collection: func(name: string, rows-json: list<u8>) -> result<_, string>;
```

Replaces a collection's rows: a JSON array of objects mapping a `#binding` name to a value
(`{"type":"bool|integer|number|text|numbers","value":…}`).

<a id="set-value"></a>

### `set-value`

```wit
set-value: func(name: string, value: value) -> result<_, string>;
```

Binds one `#binding` name for the whole screen.

Types: [`value`](server-experience-ui.md#type-value).

<a id="modal-size"></a>

### `modal-size`

```wit
modal-size: func() -> option<gui-size>;
```

This bundle's open modal's size, once it has been drawn; `none` while it is closed or not
drawn yet. `modal-resized` reports each change.

Types: [`gui-size`](server-experience-ui.md#type-gui-size).

<a id="set-text"></a>

### `set-text`

```wit
set-text: func(control: string, text: string) -> result<_, string>;
```

Sets the text of the open modal's edit boxes (`text_edit_box`) whose `text_box_name` is
`control`, as typing would leave it but cut to the box's `max_length`; it does not deliver
`text-changed`. The text holds no control characters other than line breaks.
